answers.moment: An old cat jumped up on the worktop behind her, walked slowly past the kettle and toaster and sat by the fruit bowl. She never turned round!

av_event.line_text: No, that's, honestly, I think that's a good thing. My dad's a bit like that, he just says it. Saves time.
